name: baseline
description: Typical everyday values - a tag claim present, phone on file.

name: no-phone-no-tag-claim
description: Absent clientPhone and dogTagIdField both hash as empty string - the ordinary walk-up booking shape with no tag claim.

name: email-case-and-whitespace-normalized
description: Email/name/phone carry mixed case and leading/trailing whitespace - normalization must fold to the SAME hash as the pre-trimmed baseline-equivalent value.

name: name-contains-literal-pipe
description: clientName contains a literal '|' - a naive join("|") implementation would misparse this; the hash-of-hashes design never delimits, so this is just an ordinary string.

name: unicode-name
description: Non-ASCII client name (NFC-composed) - the hash operates on raw UTF-8 bytes, no NFC normalization applied (unlike profile-tree leaf keyPaths, which DO NFC-normalize - this is a display string, not a keyPath).

name: long-service-and-large-dogtagid
description: A long serviceId string and a large decimal dogTagIdField (field elements can be much larger than a raw handle).

name: startAt-far-future
description: A large startAt (unix seconds well beyond 2^31, ruling out a 32-bit truncation bug).

name: startAt-zero
description: startAt at the unix epoch (lower boundary) - not a realistic booking time, but exercises String(0) === "0" rather than an empty string.
